## YTD Studio 2.0.0: now on Mac and iPhone, with a complete redesign

**Which file do I need?**

| File | For |
| --- | --- |
| `…-2.0.0-setup.exe` | Windows installer |
| `YTD-Studio-2.0.0-mac-arm64.dmg` | Macs with Apple Silicon (M1 and newer). **Most Macs from 2021 on.** |
| `YTD-Studio-2.0.0-mac-x64.dmg` | Intel Macs |
| `YTD-Studio-2.0.0-iOS-unsigned.ipa` | iPhone and iPad, installed with a sideloading tool (see below) |
| `YTD-Studio-2.0.0-arm64-v8a-release.apk` | Practically every Android phone. **Use this one.** |
| `YTD-Studio-2.0.0-armeabi-v7a-release.apk` | Old 32-bit Android phones |
| `YTD-Studio-2.0.0-x86_64-release.apk` | Android emulator / Chromebooks |

Not sure which Mac you have? Apple menu > About This Mac: "Chip Apple M…" is Apple Silicon, "Processor Intel…" is Intel.

### New: macOS app
The full desktop app, with everything the Windows version has: Home, Discover, Stream, Download, Library, Playlists and the AI features.

- yt-dlp and ffmpeg download themselves on first launch (or use the ones from Homebrew).
- Shortcuts use **⌘** (⌘K command palette, ⌘1–⌘7 tabs, ⌘V to open a copied link), with the usual Mac menus.
- Closing the window keeps downloads running; click the Dock icon to bring it back.

**First launch:** the app is not notarized by Apple, so macOS asks before opening it. Drag *YTD Studio* to Applications, then **right-click it > Open > Open**. On macOS 15 and newer: open it once, then go to **System Settings > Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway**.

### New: iPhone and iPad app
A native SwiftUI app.

- **Paste a link** (or open `ytdstudio://open?url=<link>` from Shortcuts) and **Watch now** without ads, with picture-in-picture and AirPlay, or **Listen** with the screen off.
- **Save video** (MP4, up to 1080p, with exact sizes for every quality) or **audio** (M4A) in one tap. A download queue with live progress, cancel and retry.
- **Library** with search, filters, sorting, favorites, watched state and *Continue watching*. Share files, save videos to Photos.
- Everything you save is also in the **Files** app: On My iPhone > YTD Studio.

**Installing:** the IPA is unsigned. Install it with [AltStore](https://altstore.io) or [Sideloadly](https://sideloadly.io), which sign it with your own Apple ID. With a free Apple ID the app has to be refreshed every 7 days (AltStore does this for you). The iOS app has no AI features or playlist downloads yet.

### 2.0 for all apps: a complete redesign
- A new **Home** screen: one link bar for videos, playlists and channels, with *Watch now*, *Listen* and one-click video and audio downloads that show their size.
- A **command palette** on desktop (Ctrl+K / ⌘K): jump anywhere, run any action, search your library, or paste a link.
- **Pause and resume** downloads (continues from the partial file, also after a restart), **download next**, Pause all / Resume all / Retry failed.
- **Clips**: save just part of a video. **SponsorBlock**: cut sponsor, self-promo and "subscribe" segments.
- **Subtitles in the player**, a **sleep timer**, and *Continue watching* everywhere.
- **Auto-sync** for followed playlists and channels, every 1 to 24 hours.
- **Backup and restore** of favorites, progress, playlists, followed channels, AI feedback and settings.
- **Accent colors**: Crimson, Violet, Ocean, Emerald, Amber and Rose, with dark, light and system themes.
- Errors are explained, with a fix where there is one (for example *Update yt-dlp and retry*).
- A **new app icon** on every platform.

> Android: if your previous APK was signed with a different key (see the README), uninstall it before installing this one.
